## Problem

What problem would this solve? Is it related to something that is missing,
awkward, or slow today? Give a concrete example if you can.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you would like. Be as specific as you can
about the behaviour and any new options or output.

## Alternatives considered

What else have you tried or considered, and why is it not enough? If there
is no alternative, say so.

## Additional context

Anything else that might help — links, screenshots, sample input or output
(with secrets and personal data removed).
